name: codemesh
description: CodeMesh: graph-assisted repository understanding and AI-supported collaborative development.

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w @codemesh/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @codemesh/shared && npm run build -w @codemesh/code-intelligence && npm run build -w @codemesh/ai && npm run build -w @codemesh/api && npm run build -w @codemesh/web && node scripts/build-public-site.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @codemesh/web && npm run typecheck -w @codemesh/api && npm run typecheck -w @codemesh/shared && npm run typecheck -w @codemesh/code-intelligence && npm run typecheck -w @codemesh/ai
